title: Static equilibrium condition
description: Essential: Correctly identifies that the spring force at the onset of motion equals the maximum static friction, leading to s = μ₀mg/k.

title: Equation of motion
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law during sliding, relating acceleration to spring extension and kinetic friction.

title: Velocity zero condition
description: Important: Sets the derived velocity function v(t) to zero to find the first stopping time t₀.

title: Stopping time solution
description: Essential: Correctly solves the transcendental equation for t₀, expressing it in terms of ω and α = arctan[(1-r)sω/v₀].

title: Spring stretch at stop
description: Important: Calculates the spring extension when the box stops, showing it simplifies to Δℓ = (2r-1)s.

title: Static friction re-engagement
description: Important: Determines the additional stretch needed after stopping for static friction to be overcome again, which is 2(1-r)s.

title: Rest time calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the subsequent rest time as the distance to re-stretch divided by the constant pulling speed, yielding 2(1-r)s/v₀.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong sign for the friction force or spring force in the equation of motion during sliding.

title: Confusing friction coefficients
description: Pitfall: Uses μ (kinetic) instead of μ₀ (static) when calculating the initial stretch s, or vice versa in the equation of motion.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions for s, a, t₀, and rest time.
